prompt_en: Ultra-realistic candid smartphone flash photograph, portrait orientation, 3:4 aspect ratio. A young East Asian woman walking quickly along a quiet urban street at night beside a long white tiled wall. Captured in a spontaneous paparazzi-style moment as she suddenly notices the camera and instinctively raises her open hand directly toward the lens to block the shot. Her body remains turned forward while her head glances back over her shoulder, revealing a subtle playful smile and direct eye contact.\\nStrong on-camera flash creates bright foreground illumination, deep shadows, and a raw nightlife aesthetic. Motion blur is visible on the raised hand and strands of hair, enhancing the sense of movement and authenticity. She wears a sleek black sleeveless dress, thin-framed glasses, small earrings, and carries a glossy black shoulder bag. Wind lightly sweeps through her long dark hair.\\nBackground features a dimly lit modern city street with distant streetlights, high-rise buildings, soft bokeh lights, and dark asphalt pavement. Composition is dynamic and slightly off-center, emphasizing the outstretched hand dominating the foreground. The image has a candid, unposed, late-night Tokyo street photography vibe, resembling an accidental snapshot captured during a fashionable evening walk. High detail, natural skin texture, realistic lighting, shallow depth of field, cinematic urban atmosphere, authentic smartphone camera quality, documentary-style realism.\\nKeywords: candid flash photography, Tokyo nightlife, paparazzi aesthetic, hand blocking camera, spontaneous street portrait, motion blur, urban night scene, fashionable minimalism, raw authentic moment, cinematic realism.\

prompt_en: Create a vertical 3:4 high-end fashion magazine cover poster featuring a young woman with wavy brown hair, colorful braided strands, and a confident studio-fashion pose as the main subject, photographed in a minimalist private studio against a warm light-gray seamless backdrop. The model sits low and slightly reclined with one oversized denim-clad leg dominating the foreground in dramatic perspective, wearing very loose dark blue jeans and a fitted white ribbed crop tank top. Her upper body is on the right side of the frame, one hand raised near her mouth, the other arm relaxed to the side; place translucent cream sunglasses on top of her hair. Preserve realistic skin texture, natural proportions, and a candid editorial attitude rather than heavy beauty retouching. Use soft studio lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, and muted neutral tones with deep denim blues and small red typography accents.\n\nDesign the image as a niche luxury fashion magazine cover. Use elegant high-contrast serif typography for the main title on the upper left, stacked in three lines reading OFF\\nDUTY\\nICON; make the word “ICON” include one red letter “O” while the rest is black. Add small uppercase sans-serif text at the top left reading “PRIVATE STUDIO EDIT” and top right reading “ISSUE No.27” with “No.27” in red. On the right side, place two compact editorial callouts: “MINIMAL\\nMOOD.” above a short red dash, then “BOLD\\nSIMPLICITY.” Below the left knee area, add a small red dash and the stacked white caption “EFFORTLESS\\nCONFIDENCE,\\nNATURAL\\nALLURE.” At the bottom center, add a large refined serif tagline reading SIMPLE. STRONG. UNAPOLOGETIC., with “UNAPOLOGETIC.” in red and the rest white. Under it, add small spaced uppercase text: “A PRIVATE EDIT FEATURING AUTHENTIC EXPRESSION\\nAND MODERN FEMININITY.” and beneath that “STUDIO ARCHIVE\\n2024 COLLECTION.” Add exactly one small vertical barcode block at the bottom left with tiny numbers. Keep the layout clean, editorial, and asymmetrical, with generous negative space on the upper left and typography integrated around the model. No extra logos, no watermark, no additional cover lines beyond the specified text.\

prompt_en:
Transform the subject from the uploaded photo into a fashion illustration created with thick oil pastels or wax crayons on textured paper.
Fashion Illustration Style: Editorial and stylish, focusing on the subject’s outfit and overall look rather than background elements. Reminiscent of fashion magazine sketches.
Medium & Tools: Rendered with bold, chunky pastel strokes. Marks are grainy, textured, and uneven, leaving visible gaps and overlaps. No digital smoothness.
Linework: No black outlines or contour lines. Shapes are defined by overlapping pastel blocks of color.
Coloring: Flat matte fills in vibrant but muted tones. Slightly imperfect coverage, with paper texture peeking through. Minimal shading using broad pastel hatching, not gradients.
Details: Preserve the subject’s hairstyle, clothing, accessories, pose, and expression exactly, but simplify them into bold pastel forms. Logos or numbers should appear as painterly pastel marks, not sharp text.
Background: Solid, off-white sketchbook paper. Only a light scribbled ground shadow to anchor the figure.
Overall Tone: Chic, modern fashion sketch aesthetic — stylish, minimal, and editorial.
Negative Prompt: No outlines, no contour ink. No gradients, no digital airbrush, no vector-smooth shapes.\

author: 余温
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,摄影,文字 / 排版,图解 / 图表
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a realistic smartphone photo of a lined notebook page on a wooden desk, showing a handwritten software/data-structure homework answer sheet in slightly messy but believable black gel-pen handwriting. The page title should be centered near the top as 第五章答案. Make it look like an actual photo submitted for class, with small imperfections, uneven writing, mild page curvature, shadows, and perspective distortion.

Canvas and camera: Vertical 3:4 photo, shot from above at a slight angle. The main notebook page fills most of the frame, tilted very slightly. The lighting is warm indoor desk lighting, with soft shadows and a realistic phone-camera look, not a flat scan.

Scene details: Use an open notebook with pale gray horizontal ruled lines and rounded page corners. A partial previous page is visible along the left edge. The notebook rests on a medium-brown wooden desk. On the right side, place a black transparent-bodied gel pen vertically near the lower-right edge, and a small white eraser with gray smudges near the upper-right corner. Add a few tiny eraser crumbs or paper debris scattered around the eraser. Keep the page off-white with subtle texture.

Handwritten content: Use Chinese handwritten notes mixed with math and C-style pseudocode. The handwriting should be neat enough to read but intentionally slightly casual and uneven, with natural spacing and occasional slant variation. Write exactly 3 numbered answer sections:

1. Section 1 contains exactly 2 subitems:
   - “(1) 叶结点数 = (k-1)m + 1。”
   - “(2) 最多结点数 = (k^h - 1)/(k - 1)，最少结点数 = k(h-1)+1。”

2. Section 2 defines WPL and contains a short explanation plus exactly 5 pseudocode lines. Write:
   - “WPL：遍历二叉树，遇到叶子就加 weight × depth，”
   - “根深度为 0。”
   - “代码大意:”
   Then center or indent the following 5 code lines beneath it:
   - “if(root == NULL) return 0;”
   - “if(!root->left && !root->right)”
   - “return root->weight * depth;”
   - “return WPL(root->left, depth+1) +”
   - “WPL(root->right, depth+1);”

3. Section 3 contains exactly 5 handwritten lines describing binary tree and forest conversion:
   - “二叉树根为 A，左子树 B-D-E-H,”
   - “右子树 C-F，其中 F下有 I、G，I下有 M,”
   - “M下有 K，G下有 J，J下有 L。”
   - “森林按左孩子右兄弟关系转换即可。”
   The section number “3.” should start on the left margin, with the text continuing across the lower half of the page.

Visual style: Photorealistic, natural shadows, realistic lined paper, black ink, casual student handwriting. The writing should look handwritten rather than printed or typeset. Slightly imperfect alignment with ruled lines is desirable.

Constraints: Do not add extra diagrams, stamps, watermarks, decorative graphics, or typed fonts. Keep exactly 3 numbered sections, exactly 2 subitems in section 1, exactly 5 pseudocode lines in section 2, and the listed Chinese homework text only.\

Goal: Create a vintage Chinese travel-and-food poster for Chaoshan featuring handmade beef balls, combining local landmark architecture, regional flavor, and retro printed-paper texture.

Canvas: Square poster, 4:5-feeling composition within a 1:1 frame, warm beige rice-paper background with heavy halftone grain, faded ink wash, slightly weathered edges, muted teal-green and sepia palette with realistic food photography blended into illustrated print style.

Layout: Large expressive dark teal Chinese brush-calligraphy dominates the upper left and center, reading “潮汕你好”. Small top-left text reads “一城一菜” with the English subtitle “ONE CITY ONE DISH”. Below the main calligraphy, add serif English text “HELLO CHAOSHAN”. On the right side, place vertical Chinese text “牛肉丸” with small vertical English text beside it reading “HANDMADE BEEF BALL”. Add a small red seal stamp near the calligraphy reading “手打”.

Background landmarks: Use three distinct architectural elements: 1) a detailed traditional arched stone bridge with a double-roof pavilion and red lanterns across the mid-right, reflected in water; 2) a pale faded skyline of old Chaoshan buildings behind the bridge; 3) a street gate and old arcade street scene in the lower left, with the sign “牌坊街”. Keep all architecture semi-illustrated, printed like an old tourism poster, with atmospheric depth and pale sepia haze.

Foreground dish: In the lower right foreground, place one large porcelain bowl of clear broth containing exactly 7 visible beef balls: six whole round beef balls and one cut-open beef ball showing the textured minced interior. Garnish with chopped green onions and cilantro. The bowl has green floral rim patterns and Chinese characters around the inside rim, filled with glossy soup highlights. The food should look appetizing and more realistic than the background, with warm lighting and shallow depth.

Additional text: In the lower left, add handwritten white Chinese slogan text “一丸入汤，满城鲜香” with two brush underline strokes. At the bottom left, add bold white Chinese brand-style text “潮味丸铺” and small English text below it “HANDMADE BEEF BALL”, plus a tiny red seal accent.

Visual style: Retro Chinese food tourism poster, screen-printed travel postcard, hand-painted landmark collage, ink-brush typography, aged paper, stippled halftone dots, layered translucent city silhouettes, nostalgic restaurant branding. Make the composition dense but balanced, with the bowl overlapping the lower architecture.

Constraints: Use exactly 7 visible beef balls and exactly 3 main landmark/background architectural elements. Preserve the specified Chinese and English text accurately. Avoid modern neon, flat vector minimalism, people, logos, QR codes, or watermarks.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a detailed Japanese-style illustrated reference sheet infographic titled 雨の日シチュの用語表, explaining useful rainy-day scene vocabulary for AI illustration prompts.

Canvas: Portrait 3:4 poster, aged cream watercolor paper with ink stains, tape, paperclips, torn memo scraps, tiny stars, raindrop doodles, umbrella doodles, and purple hydrangea decorations in the corners. Use a handmade scrapbook notebook aesthetic with thin navy divider lines and slightly worn edges.

Overall visual style: Soft anime watercolor and ink wash, melancholic rainy atmosphere, muted navy, gray, lavender, and beige palette. The recurring subject is a black-haired anime girl in a dark raincoat, usually wet from rain, carrying or standing under a transparent or black umbrella. Add reflective wet streets, mist, puddles, raindrops on glass, and blurred city lights. Keep the text dense but neatly organized like a prompt-writing cheat sheet.

Header: Large centered brush-calligraphy Japanese headline using the headline text. Under it, add a smaller Japanese subtitle line explaining that the sheet organizes rain, rainy season, puddles, and road-reflection words for AI illustration prompt support. Place a large decorative character portrait at the upper left with hydrangeas; the face area is covered by a soft square blur, matching the generated look. At the upper right, add small taped memo papers and a decorative umbrella sketch.

Main layout: A grid of exactly 24 numbered vocabulary cards, arranged 4 columns by 6 rows. Each card has a dark blue circular number badge, a bold Japanese term title, two or three short Japanese explanatory text lines, and a small anime rainy-scene thumbnail. Use thin navy borders and off-white card backgrounds. Count and label the 24 cards as follows, with these visible concepts: 1 umbrella, 2 shared umbrella, 3 transparent umbrella, 4 wet hair, 5 wet school uniform, 6 rain lodging or taking shelter from rain, 7 under the eaves, 8 bus stop, 9 rain in front of the station, 10 sudden shower, 11 rain inside a train car, 12 window glass, 13 puddle, 14 road surface reflection, 15 raindrops, 16 misty rain, 17 muddy ground, 18 cloudy sky, 19 gray sky, 20 after the rain, 21 night rain, 22 neon reflections, 23 rainy-season humidity, 24 rainy-day aftermath.

Thumbnail details: Vary every card image while keeping the same rainy anime mood. Include close-up portraits, walking scenes, umbrellas, wet clothes, bus stop, station crowd, train window, puddle reflection, neon city street, hydrangea after rain, and rainy room or alley aftermath. Cards 10 and 11 should include soft gray square blurs over part of the character face area, echoing the original censored-looking artifacts.

Bottom section: Add a wide bordered note panel titled in Japanese as a usage guide, with exactly 5 bullet points in small Japanese text explaining how to use the vocabulary list for AI illustration prompts. Decorate the bottom with washi tape, a fountain pen ink bottle, scattered clips, handwritten memo scraps, small flowers, and tiny rain icons.

Constraints: The final image must feel like an information-dense printable reference sheet, not a single illustration. Use exactly 24 numbered cards and exactly 5 bottom bullet points. Keep the Japanese calligraphy headline prominent, maintain legible grid structure, and avoid adding logos or watermarks.\

title: 手工混合媒介肖像画
author: Maverick | AI
categories: 头像 / 个人资料,海报 / 传单,插画,草图 / 线稿,水彩,肖像 / 自拍,角色,时尚单品
prompt_en:
Create a highly detailed mixed media portrait painting of the subject’s face, combining layered acrylic brush strokes, charcoal smudges, pencil sketches, rough paint splashes, collage textures, paper grain, expressive ink marks, and imperfect handcrafted details to create an authentic human-made artwork appearance. The overall composition should feel raw, artistic, and naturally imperfect, avoiding overly clean or overly polished digital results.

Use bright, eye-catching, and dynamic colors with rich tonal variation so the artwork feels vibrant and visually engaging without looking monotonous. Add visible skin texture details, layered paint textures, subtle rough strokes, and organic imperfections to enhance realism and artistic depth. The mixed media style should also influence the entire visual presentation, including the outfit and surrounding artistic elements, so the final artwork feels cohesive and fully immersed in the mixed media aesthetic.

The subject’s pose and facial expression must appear relaxed, expressive, lively, and natural, avoiding stiff body language, awkward posing, or gloomy emotional tones. The pose, angle, expression, and overall composition must be clearly different from the attached reference photo while still maintaining the subject’s identity.

The modern, stylish, casual, and fashion-forward with layered clothing details, trendy contemporary fashion elements, unique textures, and visually interesting accessories that enhance the artistic mood. Avoid plain, generic, repetitive, or standard clothing designs, and ensure the outfit is completely different from the clothing shown in the reference image.

Focus on creating a visually balanced artwork with an expressive artistic atmosphere, realistic handcrafted imperfections, rich mixed media layering, and strong emotional energy, while still maintaining an elegant and aesthetically pleasing portrait composition.\

title: 垂直切片双曝光女人

prompt_en:
A high-contrast, double-exposure editorial portrait of a beautiful woman gazing down with a thoughtful expression. The image is creatively segmented into vertical cuts of varying heights against a textured, off-white parchment background. Overlay effect: Within the vertical cuts of the woman's face, a secondary scene is visible: a solitary figure of the same woman in a sweatshirt walking along a rain-soaked street at night.

The street scene features a warm orange bokeh emanating from the streetlights and reflections on the wet pavement, creating a striking contrast with the cool tones of the portrait. Stylistic elements: Lighting: A chiaroscuro style with deep shadows and bright highlights on the woman's white shirt and dark jacket.

Texture: A subtle grain and a worn, paper-like texture cover the entire canvas, lending an artistic and raw feel. Color palette: A mix of desaturated monochromatic tones for the portrait, punctuated by vibrant touches of amber, gold, and turquoise from the rainy cityscape. Atmosphere: Melancholic, introspective, and with hints of modern film noir; facial hair and skin texture rendered in great detail.

Technical specifications: Photograph taken with an 85mm lens, f/1.8, cinematic lighting, sharp focus on the glasses, 8K resolution, graphic poster style. Aspect ratio 9:16.\

prompt_en: Ultra-realistic conceptual fashion editorial portrait of a young man with curly brown hair, light stubble, and yellow-tinted rectangular sunglasses. He wears a minimalist beige oversized t-shirt, relaxed blue denim jeans, and off-white sneakers. He stands casually in a neutral beige studio environment, one hand in his pocket and the other gripping the hair of an oversized hyper-realistic detached version of his own head hanging beside him like a heavy suitcase. The giant head is identical to him, wearing the same sunglasses and expression, rendered with extreme realism, detailed skin texture, natural facial hair, and lifelike proportions. The head appears heavy and symbolic, representing mental burden, overthinking, self-awareness, and identity. Background features integrated typography in a contemporary editorial poster style: • Handwritten black text at the top: “HEAVY” • Smaller text underneath: “ON MY OWN MIND” with “MIND” aggressively crossed out using rough black marker strokes • Massive oversized scribbled typography “HEAD” dominating the background behind the subject, drawn with chaotic sketch-like strokes and imperfect hand-drawn texture. Composition is perfectly centered with a full-body view, strong negative space, poster-like layout, and balanced typography placement. Soft diffused studio lighting creates subtle shadows and premium fashion-campaign aesthetics. Neutral taupe and beige color palette, minimalist set design, surreal conceptual storytelling, modern streetwear campaign, high-end magazine cover quality, sharp focus, natural skin texture, ultra-detailed, photorealistic, 8K resolution, cinematic editorial photography, psychological surrealism, luxury advertising aesthetic.\
